title: Man in a black duster carrying The Mothman Prophecies in a movie-theater parking lot
place_text: movie theater parking lot, Los Angeles

tellings.quote: he's holding a book. And it's the Moth Man prophecies.

plain: A man named Bryce, who worked in Hollywood with a partner named Brent, says that early in their partnership the two of them met a stranger in a long black coat in a movie theater parking lot in Los Angeles. According to Bryce, the man was holding a copy of The Mothman Prophecies, a book about strange sightings and odd events. He tells it as one of the uncanny coincidences that seemed to follow their work.
